scripts.build: pnpm run build:v-frame && pnpm run build:react-router && pnpm run build:qwik
scripts.build:qwik: vite build -c workers/qwik/vite.config.ts && vite build -c workers/qwik/vite.config.ts --ssr src/index.tsx
scripts.predev: pnpm --workspace-root run build && pnpm run build
scripts.dev:workers: concurrently -k -n host,react-router,qwik "wrangler dev --env= --port 43500 --inspector-port 43600 -c workers/host/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --env= --port 43501 --inspector-port 43601 -c workers/react-router/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --env= --port 43502 --inspector-port 43602 -c workers/qwik/wrangler.jsonc"
scripts.types: wrangler types worker-configuration.d.ts -c workers/host/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/react-router/wrangler.jsonc -c workers/qwik/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test:workers: concurrently -k -n host,react-router,qwik "wrangler dev --env test --port 44500 --inspector-port 44600 -c workers/host/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --env test --port 44501 --inspector-port 44601 -c workers/react-router/wrangler.jsonc" "wrangler dev --env test --port 44502 --inspector-port 44602 -c workers/qwik/wrangler.jsonc"
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run types && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:routing && pnpm run check:deploy
scripts.check:deploy: wrangler deploy --env= --dry-run -c workers/react-router/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env= --dry-run -c workers/qwik/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env= --dry-run -c workers/host/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.predeploy: pnpm --workspace-root run build && pnpm run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:components && wrangler deploy --env= -c workers/host/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:components: wrangler deploy --env= -c workers/qwik/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler deploy --env= -c workers/react-router/wrangler.jsonc
